scripts.sideload:mac: mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/Containers/com.microsoft.Excel/Data/Documents/wef" && cp manifest.xml "$HOME/Library/Containers/com.microsoft.Excel/Data/Documents/wef/cormac.manifest.xml" && echo 'Placed in wef. Fully quit Excel (Cmd-Q), reopen, then Home tab -> Open Cormac. Pane dev server must be running.'
scripts.sideload:mac:stop: rm -f "$HOME/Library/Containers/com.microsoft.Excel/Data/Documents/wef/cormac.manifest.xml" && echo 'Removed from wef. Cmd-Q and reopen Excel to clear it.'
